newsitem.title: CHINA: China likely to issue Securities Law within a year.
newsitem.headline: China likely to issue Securities Law within a year.

text.p: China plans to promulgate the long-awaited Securities Law in 1997 or at the latest next March when the National People's Congress, or parliament, begins its next session, the China Securities News said on Thursday.
The newspaper said a commission under the NPC would try to get the Securities Law approved this year along with a new Bankruptcy Law and a law to protect state-owned assets.
The Securities Law, which has been under discussion for four years, is still being discussed and revised, the newspaper said.
Analysts say the main obstacle is that different departments in the central government have so far failed to agree on how power and responsibility for securities matters will be apportioned.
